Running head: GREEN FINANCE AND BANK PERFORMANCE 1
Introduction
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint condition that leads to the gradual breakdown of articular
cartilage and remodelling of the underlying bone. The patient described morning stiffness
lasting less than thirty minutes, which is consistent with a mechanical rather than
inflammatory process (Brophy & Fillingham, 2022).
Management should begin with education and a structured exercise programme, because
strengthening the quadriceps reduces pain and improves function for most patients. Weight
reduction is also recommended when the body mass index exceeds the healthy range, and the
clinician should revisit these goals at every follow-up visit.
Pharmacological treatment is reserved for symptoms that do not respond to conservative
measures. Topical anti-inflammatory agents are preferred before oral agents in older adults,
since gastrointestinal and renal risks increase with age and with concurrent medication use.
Screening recommendations must be reviewed at the same consultation. According to current
guidance, adults aged forty-five to seventy-five should be offered colorectal cancer screening,
and women aged forty to seventy-four should be offered biennial mammography unless a
higher-risk pathway applies.
In summary, the evidence supports a stepped approach that prioritises non-pharmacological
care, reserves medication for persistent symptoms, and integrates preventive screening into
routine visits so that the patient's long-term health is protected.
